title: Repository and branching workflow
story: As a developer, I want a GitHub repository with a protected main branch and a feature-branch workflow so that every change is reviewed before it reaches main.
criteria: Repository exists; main requires a pull request; branch naming convention documented in the README.

title: GitHub Kanban board
story: As a project manager, I want a GitHub Projects board with Backlog, To Do, In Progress, In Review and Done columns so that the team can see the real status of every backlog item.
criteria: Board has the five named columns; every backlog issue is on the board; issues are moved as work progresses.

title: User registration
story: As a new user, I want to register with a username and password so that I can have my own private workspace.
criteria: POST /api/auth/register/ returns 201 and a token; weak passwords are rejected with 400; covered by an automated test.

title: User login
story: As a registered user, I want to log in with my credentials so that I can access my workflow items.
criteria: Valid credentials return a token; invalid credentials return 400; the React login form stores the session.

title: User logout
story: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that nobody else can use my session on a shared computer.
criteria: POST /api/auth/logout/ deletes the token; the old token then receives 401; the UI clears the local session.

title: Create workflow item
story: As a user, I want to create a workflow item with a title and description so that I can record work I need to do.
criteria: POST /api/workflow-items/ returns 201 with status Pending; empty titles are rejected in the UI.

title: View my workflow items
story: As a user, I want to see a list of my workflow items so that I know what is outstanding.
criteria: GET /api/workflow-items/ returns only the caller's items; the React page lists them.

title: Update item status
story: As a user, I want to change an item's status between Pending, In Progress and Completed so that I can track my progress.
criteria: PATCH accepts only the three valid statuses; the UI dropdown updates the item.

title: Edit workflow item
story: As a user, I want to edit the title and description of an existing item so that I can correct or refine it.
criteria: PUT/PATCH updates the item; the UI offers an Edit form with Save and Cancel.

title: Delete workflow item
story: As a user, I want to delete completed or outdated items so that my list stays relevant.
criteria: DELETE returns 204 and the item disappears from the list.

title: Per-user data isolation
story: As a user, I want my items to be invisible to other users so that my work stays private.
criteria: A second user's request never returns or modifies the first user's items; covered by an automated test.

title: Environment-variable configuration
story: As a developer, I want all configuration and secrets read from environment variables so that no credentials are committed to source control.
criteria: Django reads secret key, debug flag and hosts from the environment; React reads VITE_API_URL; .env is git-ignored and .env.example is provided.

title: Backend Dockerfile
story: As a DevOps engineer, I want a Dockerfile for the Django backend so that it builds and runs identically on every machine.
criteria: docker build succeeds; image installs from requirements.txt; runs as non-root; health check passes.

title: Frontend Dockerfile
story: As a DevOps engineer, I want a multi-stage Dockerfile for the React frontend so that a small, reproducible image is produced.
criteria: docker build succeeds using npm ci and package-lock.json; final image serves static files with nginx.

title: GitHub Actions CI pipeline
story: As a developer, I want a GitHub Actions workflow triggered on push and pull request so that every change is tested and its Docker images are built automatically.
criteria: Workflow runs tests, builds backend and frontend images and shows a green run on a pull request.

title: Automated tests in the pipeline
story: As a developer, I want backend and frontend tests to run on every push so that regressions are caught before merging.
criteria: python manage.py test and npm test run in CI; a failing test fails the pipeline.

title: Pull request review rules
story: As a team lead, I want pull requests to need a review and passing checks before merging so that code quality is maintained.
criteria: At least one review comment or approval is recorded on each pull request; CI status is visible on the PR.

title: CircleCI pipeline
story: As a DevOps engineer, I want an equivalent CircleCI pipeline so that I can compare the two tools and keep a second CI option.
criteria: .circleci/config.yml tests and builds both images with setup_remote_docker; a green pipeline run is visible in CircleCI.

title: Docker Compose stack
story: As a developer, I want a docker-compose.yml so that I can start the whole application with one command.
criteria: docker compose up --build starts frontend on :3000 and backend on :8000.

title: CI secrets management
story: As a security-conscious engineer, I want pipeline secrets stored in the CI tool's secret store so that tokens never appear in the repository or logs.
criteria: No secret values in YAML files; secrets referenced through the secrets context or project environment variables.

title: Dependency and layer caching
story: As a developer, I want pip, npm and Docker layer caches in CI so that pipelines finish faster.
criteria: Second pipeline run restores caches and is measurably faster than the first.

title: Dependency vulnerability alerts
story: As a maintainer, I want automated dependency update and vulnerability alerts so that known security issues are fixed quickly.
criteria: Dependabot (or equivalent) enabled for pip, npm and Docker base images.

title: Filter items by status
story: As a user, I want to filter my list by status so that I can focus on what is in progress.
criteria: UI offers a status filter; API supports ?status= query parameter.

title: Password reset
story: As a user, I want to reset a forgotten password by email so that I do not lose access to my account.
criteria: Reset email with a time-limited link; new password validated by Django validators.

title: Publish images to a registry
story: As a DevOps engineer, I want tagged images pushed to a container registry on merge to main so that deployments can pull a versioned artefact.
criteria: Pipeline pushes images tagged with commit SHA using registry credentials held as CI secrets.

title: Automated deployment to staging
story: As a product owner, I want successful builds on main deployed to a staging environment so that changes can be demonstrated quickly.
criteria: Deployment job runs after tests pass and exposes a staging URL.

title: Structured logging and monitoring
story: As an operations engineer, I want structured application logs and uptime checks so that failures are noticed quickly.
criteria: JSON logs written to stdout; health endpoint monitored.
